items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: Abbey was there. That's right, he was playing with you when I was.

ctx.x: That's farther then. Guess there's no music down there now at Mary's? No, they cut up so bad I'm going to tell you. Last time I played down there, them boys got to fighting and we started playing music, thought it would stop them. Man, somebody put the lights out. Somebody throw the table, and the table come over there by me, and I sat down behind the music box and it paid off like a slot machine, you know when you hit the jackpot, ding-a-ling-a-ling. Because you grabbed the money. No, I sat there and my…
I remember a lot of young kids, like high school kids all the time I was there. That's right.
